title: ci(ui-merge): port the four objectui gates that guard published @object-ui packages into root CI
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UWsef2B9ahn2NkfVDtnHnS)_

Part of #26717 (the four "port" rows: 23, 21, 7 `test:dist`, 22. The five port-or-retire rows 19, 18, 7-docs, 17 and 26 are measured below and left for the next card.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把保护已发布 `@object-ui/*` 包的四个 objectui 检查接回根 CI。`Build & E2E UI` 多跑两步:Console 首屏体积预算(`check:eager-closure`)和 components 的构建产物测试(`test:dist`),都复用这个 job 已有的构建。新增一个只在 main 的 push/定时批次跑的 job「UI Published Artifacts」:先跑一次和发布相同的 `pnpm build`,再跑两个检查,一个查发布包里有没有测试文件,一个查每个 ESM 入口能不能被 Node 直接加载。`scripts/release-publish.sh` 在 `changeset publish` 之前先扫一遍,扫出问题就拒绝发布。
- 为什么改:objectui 并入后,这四个检查没有在任何地方跑过。18.2.0 发 `@object-ui/*` 时也没有经过发布前的那道扫描。
- 风险与回滚:`Build & E2E UI` 是必需检查,多出的两步会挡 PR。这两步在 main 上实测是绿的,首屏体积还有 481 KB 余量。新 job 不是必需检查,PR 和合并队列都不跑它。但发布审批前读的全量批次里会有它,它红了算 main-red。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 末尾新增的 `ui-published-artifacts` job;`scripts/release-publish.sh` 新增的拒发段;`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` 改写的接线测试(这一处要你拍板,见决策卡)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test`,预期 169 例全过,其中第 16 组有 12 例,包括「扫出测试文件就拒绝发布、changeset publish 不会运行」。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(Tier H),并在线程里回答行 23 的位置问题(推荐 B,本 PR 就是按 B 做的)。

## What changes

Rows of the objectstack#25697 workflow roster, ported from the objectui workflows deleted by #26058. Invocations were read at that PR's parent `be789779` (`published-dist-gate.yml`, `node-esm-load-gate.yml`, `performance-budget.yml`, `ci.yml` "Test (dist pins)").

| Row | Gate | Where it runs now | Step name |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22 | `check:eager-closure` | `Build & E2E UI`, over the Console build the job already makes. On a pull request, a step before it resolves the base branch's ceiling constants (objectui#6245 freshness half), ported from `performance-budget.yml`. | `check:eager-closure — resolve the base-branch ceiling constants`, `check:eager-closure — weigh the Console's eager closure against its budget` |
| 7 | `test:dist` on `@object-ui/components` | `Build & E2E UI`. The root turbo task's `dependsOn: ["build"]` replays the registry build the SDUI manifest step already ran. | `test:dist — run the built-artifact pins of @object-ui/components` |
| 23 | `check:published-dist` | New full-battery job `UI Published Artifacts`, after `pnpm build`, with `--no-build`. Also `scripts/release-publish.sh`, before npm's record starts, refusing on a non-zero exit. | `check:published-dist — scan every published @object-ui tarball for tooling files` |
| 21 | `check:node-esm-load` (load leg) | Same job, same build, `--no-build`. It runs whatever the scan above said. | `check:node-esm-load — import every published ESM entry under plain Node` |

- **`ui-published-artifacts`** (`UI Published Artifacts`): `if:` is Build & E2E UI's condition plus `github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'`, the full-battery spelling. So a pull request and a queue entry skip it, `main`'s push and 4-hourly schedule runs carry it, and `scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate` reads it before a publish approval. It is not a required context. Its setup is spelled out (Node, pnpm, a restore-only store cache, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) rather than the `setup-workspace` composite, because `check-pre-install-import-graph.mjs` reads a job with no literal `pnpm install` as running entirely before `node_modules` exists, and both gates import `typescript`. It restores the build-core / ui-deps turbo seeds (restore-only). `timeout-minutes: 60`, objectui's bound for each of the two builds it replaces.
- **Why `pnpm build` + `--no-build`.** The gate's own build mode is not the release's build. `check:published-dist` builds `turbo run build --filter=!@object-ui/site` from `ui/`, which under the monorepo is 128 tasks including `@objectstack/docs`; the release builds `pnpm build` (no docs). `check:node-esm-load`'s build mode runs `pnpm build` in `ui/`, which has no `build` script (measured: `ERR_PNPM_RECURSIVE_EXEC_FIRST_FAIL Command "build" not found`, exit 254). Building once with the release's command and grading with `--no-build` is the order the publish path runs the scan in. `--no-build` cannot pass vacuously: a package with nothing under its build output is `no-build-output`, both gates assert a floor, and the ESM gate's provenance leg still refuses an artifact whose turbo log names another tree.
- **`scripts/release-publish.sh`** runs `node ui/scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs --no-build` after the `npm_config_globalconfig` unset and before `--start-npm-record`, so the scan's `npm pack --dry-run` runs never land in the record `release-verify-npm.mjs` reads back. A non-zero exit prints an `::error::` and exits 1 before `changeset publish`.
- **THE TWO SPEEDS** header in `ci.yml` now names four full-battery jobs.

### Forced test edits

- `scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs` battery 16 (floor 8 → 12). Its run of `release-publish.sh` would otherwise run the real scan over an unbuilt tree. It now stubs `npm` on `PATH` (answering `npm pack --dry-run --json` with one build-output file, plus a `dist/__tests__/*.test.js` when asked; the stub writes a debug log into `npm_config_logs_dir` like real npm). New cases: the scan packs every published package before `changeset`; npm's record holds only the publish's log; a tarball with tooling material exits 1 with `Refusing to publish`; and then `changeset` and `git` are never called. The existing call-order case filters out the `npm pack` lines.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts` (own commit, option B on the thread's decision card). The pin `is NOT wired into any per-PR workflow` read the ruling (objectui#4846 comment 5307574139: no per-PR full-repo build) per workflow FILE, so no job of `ci.yml` (which subscribes `pull_request`) could carry the scan. It now reads per JOB: in any workflow that subscribes `pull_request` or `merge_group`, a job that runs the scan must deny both events in its own `if:`, and the loop must find at least one carrier. The retired `runs nightly` pin comes back as `runs in ci.yml's full battery, after the release's build, with --no-build`. If option A or C is chosen instead, this commit is dropped and the job moves or loses its first step.

## Why

The roster kept these four as "kept, follow-up port", and #26058 deleted their only runners. Since then nothing has run them: 18.2.0 published `@object-ui/*` without the published-dist scan, and a Console first-load regression would land unmeasured. Card #26717 has the business case.

## Tests

Measured on head `f0665932` (the final head `8090d1fa` differs on this PR's paths only in the new job's setup steps, spelled out instead of the composite; the gate commands, scripts and `release-publish.sh` are unchanged) in this worktree, after a cold `pnpm build` (116 tasks, 13m50s under `os-verify-lock`, shared box):

<details><summary>The four gates as the CI steps spell them (all exit 0)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui run check:published-dist --no-build`: exit 0, 241 s. `Inspected 36 published package(s): 5799 tarball file(s), 5654 of them build output, 0 tooling artifact(s) in build output.`
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:node-esm-load --no-build`: exit 0, 81 s. `Provenance leg: 35 of 35 gradable entries were built by this tree.` `Load leg: 33 of 36 published ESM entries imported and evaluated.` (create-plugin is bin-only; plugin-dashboard and plugin-map are the ruled `.css` boundary.)
- `VITE_BASE_PATH=/console/ pnpm --dir ui/apps/console exec vite build`, then `pnpm --dir ui run check:eager-closure`: exit 0. `Console eager closure is 1950.2 KB gzipped across 89 of 2392 chunks (budget: 2431.6 KB, headroom: 481.4 KB).` Per-chunk, membership and sensitivity halves all ✅; freshness not applicable off a pull request.
- `pnpm exec turbo run test:dist --filter=@object-ui/components`: exit 0, `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- PR freshness step rehearsed: its `run:` extracted from this `ci.yml`, run under `bash -e` with `PR_BASE_SHA=8b276385`, `BASE_REF=main`: exit 0, then the checker with `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request` and those five variables: exit 0, `Ceiling freshness: all 3 ceiling constants are unchanged on main since this checkout's base`.
- `node scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test`: `OK … 169 cases pass across 16 batteries`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-published-dist-tooling.test.ts`: 33 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Counter-probes (each defect turned its step red, then was restored)</summary>

One locked script, every mutation restored by trap and checked by sha256 or `git diff HEAD`:

- Row 23: `ui/packages/core/dist/probe-26717.test.d.ts` written into a built dist. `check:published-dist --no-build` exit 1: `@object-ui/core  [tooling-in-published-output]  packages/core/dist/probe-26717.test.d.ts`. The release-path spelling `node ui/scripts/check-published-dist-tooling.mjs --no-build` exit 1 too. Restored (file absent). Battery 16's tooling case is the same refusal through `release-publish.sh`.
- Row 21: `export * from './probe26717extless'` appended to built `ui/packages/react/dist/index.js`. `check:node-esm-load --no-build` exit 1: `✗ @object-ui/components (via @object-ui/react): ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND …/react/dist/probe26717extless`, 21 lines naming it. Restored, sha matches.
- Row 22: `eager-closure.json` grown by 700,000 gzip bytes. `check:eager-closure` exit 1: `❌ Console eager closure is 2633.8 KB gzipped across 89 chunks — 202.2 KB over the 2431.6 KB budget.` Restored, sha matches; re-run exit 0.
- Row 7: through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, `namespace: 'page'` → `namespace: 'probe26717'` on `page:header`'s registration in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`. `turbo run test:dist --filter=@object-ui/components` rebuilt the package and exited 1: `× registers page:header from the BUILT bundle`. Restored (`git diff HEAD` empty); re-run exit 0.
- Release path, mutation-free: battery 16's `a tarball carrying tooling material fails the script` and `changeset publish never runs` cases.

CI run ids per gate go on the card once a `main` push run and this PR's run exist: this PR's run covers the two `Build & E2E UI` steps; `UI Published Artifacts` first runs on the push that lands this.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The five rows left for the next card**, measured on `origin/main` `8b276385`: no root workflow runs any of them.
  - Row 19 `lockfile-integrity` (`check:lockfile-integrity`): root `validate-deps.yml` has no duplicate-dependency step (its steps are changeset-fixed, override-consistency, vendor-export-contract-resolve, OSV and outdated), so no overlap to retire it on. One ui test reads the script.
  - Row 18 `lockfile-dedupe` (`check:lockfile-dedupe`): no root workflow runs `pnpm dedupe --check`; #25920 measured 145 runs / 90 days, 0 failures. One ui test reads it.
  - Row 7-docs `@object-ui/site`: no root workflow builds it, and root `pnpm build` excludes `./ui*/apps/site`.
  - Row 17 `live-e2e` (`test:e2e:live:ci`): no root carrier; one ui test reads `playwright.live.config`.
  - Row 26 `shadcn-check` (`shadcn:check`): no root carrier; three ui tests read `shadcn-sync`.
- **The rest of objectui's budget step is not ported.** It also held the entry chunk to 350 KB gzipped, ran `check-eager-locale-catalogues.mjs` (alias `check:eager-locale-catalogues`), `check:sdui-registration-pins`, a package size report and a PR comment. None of them runs in root CI today. The card names `check:eager-closure` only; the rest is next-card material.
- **Found, not fixed here:** `pnpm --dir ui run check:node-esm-load` without `--no-build` exits 1 in the monorepo (`ui/package.json` has no `build` script). And `check:published-dist`'s own build mode builds `@objectstack/docs`, unlike the release it claims to match. Both are ui script defects; this PR routes around neither: CI and the release call the gates with `--no-build` after the release's own build. Fixing the scripts' build modes is a ui-lane card (and `ui/package.json` is held by open #26556).
- `release.yml`'s comment over the publish step still describes `release-publish.sh` as `changeset publish` followed by one tag push; it now runs the scan first. Not edited here (outside the claimed surface).
- The `check-node-esm-load.mjs` docblock says `--no-build` "is wired into nothing"; this PR wires it. Not edited (ui script, outside the surface).
- No new required context. `Build & E2E UI` (required) gains three steps, about 1 to 2 minutes on top of its measured 312 s run (schedule run 40537439467) against its 35-minute bound.

## Verification

Final head `8090d1fa` (the branch with `origin/main` 0ea90c7a merged in; no overlapping files). After a fresh `pnpm build` (13m22s), the sweep ran every command `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this change set (4 paths) under `os-verify-lock` (VERDICT command-exit 0, 44m35s).

<details><summary>Gate sweep and reconciliation</summary>

- 71 derived commands, 71 run, all `exit 0`. Among them: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (178 files, 5066 tests passed, 2 skipped), `node scripts/release-verify-npm.mjs --self-test` (169 cases across 16 batteries), `pnpm check:published-files`, and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1935 cases).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran <ledger>`: `✓ 71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 71 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`, 0 UNRUN.
- Not run locally: `pnpm lint` and the full test suites, which are CI's run.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (nothing publishes: workflow, root scripts and a ui test; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's Chinese brief).
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (the local subset per the dispatch contract; the full suite is CI's)
